FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 311
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/15/2023
Senate Bill 311 as introduced would authorize motor vehicles equipped with an automated
driving system to operate on the public roads of this state. This bill would not directly affect
state or local funding.
